definitions.explanation: A prepared medicine or chemical substance used for medical treatment, scientific research, or industrial purposes. More technical than {薬|くすり}, and often used in professional or scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {薬剤|やくざい}{師|し}に{相談|そうだん}する。
この{薬剤|やくざい}は{副作用|ふくさよう}が{少|すく}ないと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: This pharmaceutical is said to have few side effects.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{薬剤|やくざい}の{開発|かいはつ}には{長|なが}い{年月|ねんげつ}と{膨大|ぼうだい}な{費用|ひよう}がかかる。
examples.english: Developing a new pharmaceutical takes many years and enormous costs.

notes:
USAGE:
{薬剤|やくざい} is a formal, technical term for medicines and chemical agents. It is far more common in professional, medical, and scientific contexts than in everyday speech, where {薬|くすり} is preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薬剤|やくざい}{師|し} (pharmacist)
- {薬剤|やくざい}を{投与|とうよ}する (administer a drug)
- {薬剤|やくざい}{耐性|たいせい} (drug resistance)
- {薬剤|やくざい}{散布|さんぷ} (spraying chemicals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薬|くすり}: medicine (everyday term)
- {医薬品|いやくひん}: pharmaceutical product (regulatory/official term)
- {薬品|やくひん}: chemicals (broader, includes non-medical chemicals)
